label: Overlay template
description: One of OpenReel Video's overlay templates, drawn where the template puts it (not above the face): subtitle-bar (a line of text on a dark rounded bar near the bottom), lower-third (name and role on a dark card with an accent border, bottom left), hashtag-strip (a full-width dark strip with hashtags near the bottom), facecam-frame (a white rounded frame around the speaker's face). No asset. Anchor it to the words it should cover; use the first to the last word for the whole video.

text.help: subtitle-bar: the line; hashtag-strip: the hashtags

role.help: lower-third: the line under the name
